changes.description: PR #15 review round 4 — ATR stop selection made a plain nested computation (removed the `if stop_loss_method == "atr"` gate so it can't re-bind the exit elif; only the in_position guard remains); added test_atr_mode_open_position_actually_exits asserting the ATR-mode position genuinely closes in-loop (stop-hit), not via the end-of-run close
